resources.string: An update of the “ADB-phon Clouds” module is available: %1$s → %2$s. Update now?
On start the program downloads the new version of the “ADB-phon Clouds” module by itself. The Install window with versions and progress is always shown.
The clouds module is not installed
Cloud drives stop working until the module is installed. Cloud accounts and settings are kept in the program itself (clouds.conf) and stay: after installing the module again everything comes back.
